title: pseudognaphalium chrysocephalum
intro: Pseudognaphalium chrysocephalum, commonly known as Yellow Button, is a flowering plant native to Australia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to soothe wounds and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Pseudognaphalium chrysocephalum include reducing inflammation, fighting bacterial infections, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and diterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
